key_points: Positive Phase 3 Caplyta data in bipolar I mania reinforces Intra-Cellular acquisition thesis, but was largely anticipated and incremental
ICOTYDE (icotrokinra) FDA approval for psoriasis extends immunology franchise against Stelara biosimilar erosion, a genuine positive
Stock has already returned ~58% over 12 months and trades ~40% above GF Value, suggesting much pipeline news is priced in
Generic dividend-defensive articles and side stories (former J&J CEO's Enveda) are noise with no direct JNJ impact
Net: solid fundamental progress but limited near-term upside from current valuation; hold rather than add
